summary: FS KKR Capital Corp (FSK) entered a Purchase Agreement with KKR Alternative Assets L.P. to issue $150M in convertible perpetual preferred stock. The preferred shares carry a $25.00 liquidation preference and a 5.00% cash dividend (or 7.00% PIK). Closing is conditioned on a concurrent third-party tender offer for up to $150M of FSK common stock, HSR clearance, and customary conditions, expected 11 business days after tender expiration. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes, including share repurchases or debt repayment. The preferred stock ranks senior to common stock. Watch for tender offer results and HSR timeline.
